request.spec:
On a client's page show me just their active projects by default. Give me a way to also see
the finished and hidden ones.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
On a client's page show me just their active projects by default. Give me a way to also see
the finished and hidden ones.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Let me summarize the full-stack change I made:

## Summary

The change request — *"show just active projects by default, with a way to also see finished and hidden ones"* — implemented as a small, additive, local change across all three layers:

**Front-end** (`src/main/frontend/features/clients/ClientProjects.tsx`)
- Default view now filters to **active** projects (`status === 'ACTIVE' && !archived`).
- Added a `client-projects-show-all` toggle button that reveals *all* projects (finished + archived) when pressed, flipping back to active-only on a second press.
- Added a `project-status` cell so the newly-revealed statuses are visible. The existing `client-projects-table`, `project-row-<id>`, and `project-name` anchors are preserved.

**Server** (`src/main/java/.../ListClientProjectsLogic.java`)
- `GET /api/clients/{clientId}/projects` now returns the client's **full** project list (via `findByClientIdOrderByIdAsc`), each row carrying its `status` and `archived` flag, so the page can filter client-side. Previously it dropped archived rows entirely, which would have made the "show all" view impossible.

**Seed support** (`TestSupportController.java`)
- Extended the project seed INSERT to honor the fixture's `archived` flag (it was previously ignored), so seeded hidden projects land in the DB as hidden.

**Database** (`V22__project_client_status_index.sql`)
- New additive migration adding an index on `project(client_id, status, archived)` to keep the per-client filtered lookup cheap. No applied migration was edited.

The Playwright acceptance test passes: default view shows 1 active project, and the toggle reveals all 3.
